results.description:
TALIA

Two years ago I found forty million dollars that wasn't where it should be. I wrote it up. Four days later I was fired, and every firm in the city was told I was unstable.

Now I pour drinks for a living. And one night I throw one in the face of the billionaire whose fund I lost everything over.

He doesn't even blink. He texts me at two in the morning instead.

He wants me to find his thief. And the only cover that gets me into his office, his parties and his home is pretending to be his girlfriend.

Sixty days. A fortune. My name back. His rules on an index card in his breast pocket: no kissing on the mouth, no staying over, no lies.

My best friends bet I can't make the man smile in thirty days.

I intend to make him do a lot more than smile.

PIERCE

They call me the Iceberg. I've earned it. Nobody has seen me smile in six years, and I don't plan to start for a bartender from Brooklyn with a temper and a pair of gold hoops.

But she's the only person who ever saw the rot in my company and said so out loud. Everyone else kept quiet.

So I hire her. I give her my office, my nights, the combination to my safe. I give her my rules, and I watch her break them one by one.

She doesn't kiss me on the mouth. She finds every other place.

I don't tell her what I wrote about her on the day she walked in.

Somebody close to me is stealing. The closer she gets to the truth, the closer she gets to me.

And I have never wanted to lose control this badly in my life.

This is the third book in The Bosshole Series. Reading order:

Taming the Bosshole.

Falling for the Bosshole.

Tempting the Bosshole.

Boss After Dark.

An Heir for the Boss.

Say Yes to the Boss.
